author: 𝐌₳𝐋𝐈𝐄𝐋
text:
How I plan my week in under 10 minutes.

Most people plan their week around tasks.

I plan mine around progress.

Every Sunday, I write down just 3 things:

1. One thing that will make me money.
A client, an application, a partnership, a sale.

2. One thing that will make me better.
Learn a skill. Read. Finish a lesson. Practice.

3. One thing that will make my week easier.
Plan content. Organize my workspace. Clear pending tasks.

That's it.

No endless to-do lists.

Just three priorities that move my life forward.

Give it a shot today. You'll be surprised how much clarity you get this week.
